_comment: DRAFT deterministic Rating / Sentiment rules, applied only to stocks whose Universal Sheet Rating / Sentiment cell is blank, and only when approved = true. A value typed in the Universal Sheet always wins. Inputs are parsed from the Result Line: revenue YoY % ('Rev +12.3% YoY'), PAT YoY % ('PAT -18.5% YoY'), a turnaround ('PAT Rs 71cr vs loss ...') or a loss ('Net loss ...'). Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Thresholds are in percent.

rules.note: swung to profit with revenue up 15%+
